targetSelector.description: Workloads to which the Gluetun container is added. Defaults to the primary workload.

env.description: Environment variables of the gluetun container, for the VPN settings.

basePath.description: Path in the container where the secret files are mounted.

defaultMode.description: Octal file mode of the mounted files, for example `0777`.

data.description: Files of the secret, keyed by file name.

namespace.description: Namespace of the secret. Defaults to the namespace of the release.

annotationsList.description: Additional annotations as a list of name and value pairs, merged into the annotations.

labelsList.description: Additional labels as a list of name and value pairs, merged into the labels.

type.description: Kubernetes type of the secret, eg `Opaque`.

additionalProperties.description: Define a secret that is mounted into the Gluetun container.

secret.description: Secrets mounted into the Gluetun container, for example the WireGuard configuration. Each key is a name for the secret.
